text: At its meeting on September 6, 2017, Etobicoke York Community Council adopted, with amendments, Item EY24.47 "Traffic Calming – Old Burnhamthorpe Road, between Burnhamthorpe Road (east leg) and Burnhamthorpe Road (west leg)," which authorized polling to be undertaken to determine support for Traffic Calming on Old Burnhamthorpe Road. The amendment approved by Community Council authorized polling for speed humps in Recommendation 1, and polling for traffic calming islands in Recommendation 2. Following detailed discussion with Transportation Services Staff, it has become evident that direction for additional polling on traffic calming islands is not required and poses a challenge to the process. In order to move ahead with the process as quickly as possible, I recommend that the authorization for polling on traffic calming islands be removed.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item EY24.47, headed "Traffic Calming – Old Burnhamthorpe Road, between Burnhamthorpe Road (east leg) and Burnhamthorpe Road (west leg)", adopted, as amended, by Etobicoke York Community Council on September 6, 2017. 2. Deleted Recommendation 2, which refers to polling on traffic calming islands. 3. Requested the City Clerk to move forward with the polling as soon as practically possible.
